senses.zh: 那么，那样的话，这样一来（表推论或结果，常接在 if 从句后）

example.en: The dog was then sent back to the U.S. on a private charter jet.
example.zh: 这只狗随后乘坐私人包机被送回了美国。

then.note: 给C的口径：back then / since then / by then / until then / just then 按2（那时）；if/when…, then… 以及 OK then、What about…, then?、None of us, then, is… 这类推论语气按1；and then 表时间先后按0，表追加理由（And then there's the expense, too. / Then you should also account for…）按3；now and then / every now and then 标 P:now and then；but then (again)（不过话说回来）标 P:but then，表「但后来」仍按0。卷面说明 Then mark the corresponding letter… 按0。0 与 1 的边界（and then 引出结果，如 id 22、77）有主观成分。

example.en: Research has found that having access to diverse teachers is beneficial for children.
example.zh: 研究发现，接触多元化的教师对孩子有益。

research.note: 给C的口径：作定语（research team / grant / firm / fellow / partners、非专名的 research institute）按0；do one's research 按0；Pew Research Center、Savanna Agricultural Research Institute 这类机构专名里的 research 标 X。

senses.zh: 构成过去完成时（had done，表示在过去某时之前已经）
进行，从事；经历，遭受（had a break / had an operation / had trouble）
让，使，请（人做某事）（had sb do / had sth done）

example.en: And alarmed locals contacted police, thinking they had heard bombs going off.
example.zh: 惊慌的当地居民报了警，以为自己听到了炸弹爆炸声。

had.form: have 的过去式和过去分词
had.note: 给C的口径：had + 过去分词（含 had been doing、倒装 had they found…、省略的 than they actually had）按0；has/have had 里的 had 按实义标（have had concerns 按1）；had to 按2（不作P）；had better 标 P:had better；have sth in common 标 P:have sth in common；have to do with 标 P:have to do with；had no idea、had a chance、had the privilege of、had an impact 按1；had an operation / hemispherectomies / blood tests / a break / phone conversations / trouble / conflict 按3；had a disease / health problems / a swollen ankle 按5；had sb do、had sth done（含选项里的 had its planes land、had two flights mixed up、had things published）按4，但 had a chicken bone lodged in her lung 这类「身上有」按1。

senses.zh: 学年，年级；年度（school year / freshman year）

example.en: Last year Britain even appointed a minister for loneliness.
example.zh: 去年英国甚至任命了一位孤独事务大臣。

year.note: 给C的口径：school / academic / freshman year、the first year of high school 按1；…-year-old 按2；all year round 标 P:all year round；year after year 标 P:year after year；year-over-year、a year、per year、the year 2020 按0；泛指节日的 New Year / Lunar New Year（含 New Year resolution）按0，Lunar New Year Parade 这类活动专名标 X。

senses.zh: 很，非常（口语：not too bad / You're too kind）

example.en: Too many people are addicted to smartphones.
example.zh: 太多人沉迷于智能手机了。

too.note: 给C的口径：too + 形容词/副词 + to do（含 too much/many…to do、too…for sb to do、a bit too much to let go）标 P:too...to；not a moment too soon（早该如此）标 P:not a moment too soon；me too、I think so too、句中 X, too, … 按1；much too、a bit too、too many/much、too often、too + 形容词 + a + 名词 按0；not too / only too 表「很」按2。注意 we say yes to too many things we don't want to do 这类 to do 属于从句，不算 too...to，按0。

senses.zh: 好，令人满意地（do well / sleep well）
嗯，好吧，那么（口语开头或停顿）
充分地，很（用在过去分词或形容词前：well known / well prepared）
远远地，大大地（well before / well into）
良好的，令人满意的（All is well.）

well.note: 给C的口径：as well as（以及）标 P:as well as，但 do/perform (just) as well as… 表「和…一样好」的比较按0；句末 as well（也）标 P:as well；might/may as well 标 P:might as well；go down well（受欢迎）标 P:go down well；go well with（与…相配）标 P:go well with；well-being 标 P:well-being；well + 过去分词/形容词（well known / documented / preserved / protected / received / treated / equipped / prepared / looked after）一律按2；well 修饰动词（do / perform / sleep / cook / land well、how well）按0；well before / into / above 按3；口语 Well, … 及句中插入的 well, 按1。0 与 2 按语法形式划界，不再按语义细分。听力原文里口语 Well 极多，首要义项可能因此是 int.，请复核是否合适。

senses.zh: 不同的，有区别的；各种不同的
另一个，别的（a different + 单数名词）

example.en: It is completely different from other outdoor games.
example.zh: 它和其他户外游戏完全不同。

different.note: 给C的口径：「不同的」与「各种的」合并为0（different kinds of、different people、be different from 都按0）；a/an different + 单数名词表「另一个、别的」（a different route / world / race / language / matter / picture）按1，但 each … a different … 表「各不相同」按0；表「与众不同、新花样」（this one was different、try something different）按2。0/2 的边界有主观成分。
